_metadata.description: Calibrated noise-relative default filter parameters for ctfilter
_metadata.selection_rule: Maximize air-ROI noise reduction subject to edge broadening <= 10% on aligned rim and normalized leakage ratio <= 1.30x; if no candidate admissible, select candidate minimizing leakage subject to edge broadening <= 10% (marked 'no admissible setting; mildest/lowest-leakage default')
_metadata.noise_estimator: Immerkaer / Laplacian MAD: sigma_hat = median(|I * M|) / (0.67448975 * 6.0)

Gaussian.selection_rule: uncalibrated practical default; no candidate met leakage <= 1.30x (calibrated minimum-leakage setting sigma=0.3 was near-identity with 1.19% noise reduction)
Gaussian.calibrated_finding: Grid search found sigma=0.3 minimizes leakage (1.715x) among broadening <= 10%, but achieves only 1.19% noise reduction. Sigma=1.0 provides 55.63% noise reduction with +4.20% broadening.

Bilateral.selection_rule: Maximizes air noise reduction among candidates satisfying edge broadening <= 10% and leakage <= 1.30x

Diffusion.selection_rule: Maximizes air noise reduction among candidates satisfying edge broadening <= 10% and leakage <= 1.30x

Wiener.selection_rule: Maximizes air noise reduction among candidates satisfying edge broadening <= 10% and leakage <= 1.30x

Median.selection_rule: uncalibrated default (single candidate r=1 px; no candidate met leakage <= 1.30x)

Morphology.selection_rule: uncalibrated default (single candidate opening r=1 px; no candidate met leakage <= 1.30x)
